Minecon Capes.name: 2011 Minecon Cape
Minecon Capes.description: The 2011 Minecon Cape was given to all attendees of the 2011 Minecon convention.

Minecon Capes.name: 2012 Minecon Cape
Minecon Capes.description: The 2012 Minecon Cape was given to all attendees of the 2012 Minecon convention.

Minecon Capes.name: 2013 Minecon Cape
Minecon Capes.description: The 2013 Minecon Cape was given to all attendees of the 2013 Minecon convention.

Minecon Capes.name: 2015 Minecon Cape
Minecon Capes.description: The 2015 Minecon Cape was given to all attendees of the 2015 Minecon convention.

Minecon Capes.name: 2016 Minecon Cape
Minecon Capes.description: The 2016 Minecon Cape was given to all attendees of the 2016 Minecon convention.

Minecon Capes.name: Minecraft Experience Cape
Minecon Capes.description: Players can receive this cape by redeeming a code rewarded after completing the experience.

Minecon Capes.name: Moonlight Trail Cape
Minecon Capes.description: Players can receive this cape by redeeming a code sent by e-mail within 72 hours after completing the experience.

Minecon Capes.name: Crafter Cape
Minecon Capes.description: This cape could be obtained at the in-person TwitchCon 2026 event in Rotterdam

Social Media Capes.name: Builder Cape
Social Media Capes.description: The Builder Cape was given to viewers who watched a Minecraft TikTok or Twitch livestream for at least 3 minutes on Tiktok and 5 minutes on Twitch.

Social Media Capes.name: Purple Heart Cape
Social Media Capes.description: The Purple Heart Cape was given to viewers who watched a Minecraft Twitch stream for at least 10 minutes.

Social Media Capes.name: Follower's Cape
Social Media Capes.description: The Follower's Cape was given to viewers who watched a Minecraft TikTok live stream for at least 3 minutes.

Social Media Capes.name: Menace Cape
Social Media Capes.description: The Menace Cape was given to viewers who watched a Minecraft TikTok livestream for at least 3 minutes.

Social Media Capes.name: Home Cape
Social Media Capes.description: The Home Cape was given to viewers who watched a Minecraft Twitch livestream for at least 3 minutes.

Event Capes.name: Zombie Horse Cape
Event Capes.description: The Zombie Horse Cape could be obtained as a reward for the "Spear Mayhem" challenge

Event Capes.name: Copper Cape
Event Capes.description: The Copper Cape could be obtained as the final reward of a special three-part community challenge known as "The Copper Cape Quest"

Event Capes.name: Yearn Cape
Event Capes.description: The Yearn Cape was obtained by completing all 6 quests in the "A Minecraft Movie Live Event"

Event Capes.name: Mojang Office Cape
Event Capes.description: The Mojang Office cape was obtained by completing all five daily challenges in the Eerie Mojang Office Party event server.

Event Capes.name: MCC 15th Year Cape
Event Capes.description: The MCC 15th Year Cape was given to those who participated in the Minecraft Championship event celebrating 15 years of Minecraft.

Event Capes.name: 15th Anniversary Cape
Event Capes.description: In order to get the cape, users had to go to Minecraft.net and claim it from a section on the 15th anniversary page.

Event Capes.name: Founder's Cape
Event Capes.description: The Founder's Cape was available for free on the Minecraft Bedrock Marketplace for a limited time.

Event Capes.name: Cherry Blossom Cape
Event Capes.description: The Cherry Blossom Cape was given to players who cast their vote during the 2023 Mob Vote.

Pride Capes.name: Pan Cape
Pride Capes.description: The Pan Cape was available for free on the Minecraft Bedrock Marketplace for a limited time on.

Pride Capes.name: Progress Pride Cape
Pride Capes.description: The Progress Pride Cape was available for free on the Minecraft Bedrock Marketplace for a limited time.

Special Capes.name: Migrator Cape
Special Capes.description: The Migrator Cape was given to players who successfully migrated their Mojang account to a Microsoft account.

Special Capes.name: Vanilla Cape
Special Capes.description: Players were able to obtain the cape under the condition that both Java Edition and Bedrock Edition for Windows are owned in the same Microsoft account.

Special Capes.name: Common Cape
Special Capes.description: The Common Cape was given to players who used their Microsoft account to log into Bedrock Edition on any platform during the distribution period.

Personalized Capes.name: Bacon Cape
Personalized Capes.description: This cape was given to Miclee by Notch for his idea of adding pigmen.

Personalized Capes.name: Millionth Customer Cape
Personalized Capes.description: This cape was given to akronman1, who purchased the 1,000,000th copy of the game.

Personalized Capes.name: dB Cape
Personalized Capes.description: This cape was given to the video game music composer dannyBstyle as Notch was a fan of his music.

Personalized Capes.name: Snowman Cape
Personalized Capes.description: This cape was given to JulianClark as a reward for making a meme about how he brought Ray Cokes to Notch because of a joke splash text that was in Minecraft at the time.

Personalized Capes.name: cheapsh0t's Cape
Personalized Capes.description: The cape is almost identical to the Translator Cape, but depicts a Japanese flag on its underside.

Personalized Capes.name: Spade Cape
Personalized Capes.description: This cape was given to MrMessiah as gratitude for developing the BetterLight mod, which got integrated into the game and was responsible for Minecraft's lighting and grass features.

Personalized Capes.name: Prismarine Cape
Personalized Capes.description: This cape was given to Drullkus by Jeb as appreciation for creating his own prismarine block texture for the Chisel mod instead of modifying Mojang's textures.

Personalized Capes.name: Turtle Cape
Personalized Capes.description: This cape was given to billyK_ for his suggestion of turtles, which was implemented into the game.

Personalized Capes.name: Birthday Cape
Personalized Capes.description: This cape was given to the account Gr8Bizzo, which is the account of Todd Baldwin.

Personalized Capes.name: Valentine Cape
Personalized Capes.description: This cape was given to LolFoxy2 by a Mojang employee, Ekkelangelo who started to become friends with LolFoxy2 and resolved their migration problems with their alternative account.

Personalized Capes.name: Oxeye Cape
Personalized Capes.description: This cape was randomly given to the player iSxckk, presumably by accident, then removed the next day.

Personalized Capes.name: Blueprint Cape
Personalized Capes.description: This cape was given to SupaCookiebrat and then removed.

Staff Capes.name: 4J Studios Cape
Staff Capes.description: This cape was presumably given out to 4J Studios developers on Xbox 360 Edition through the "Title Managed Storage" developer feature. However, it may simply be an unused asset, as no reliable sources have acknowledged the cape outside of the data dump that revealed it.

Staff Capes.name: Mojang Cape
Staff Capes.description: The Classic Mojang Cape was given to those employed by Mojang at any point.

Staff Capes.name: Mojang Studios Cape
Staff Capes.description: The Mojang Studios Cape is exclusively given to Mojang Studios employees.

Staff Capes.name: Xbox Cape
Staff Capes.description: This cape was given out to Microsoft employees, who were also given the ability to toggle the cape's visibility.

Volunteer Capes.name: Moderator Cape
Volunteer Capes.description: This cape is given to current and past moderators on Mojira.

Volunteer Capes.name: Realms MapMaker Cape
Volunteer Capes.description: The design is based on the logo for the Atlas submission portal, the web interface used by invited creators to upload their maps for review.

Volunteer Capes.name: Translator Cape
Volunteer Capes.description: The Translator Cape is given to volunteers who have contributed translations for Minecraft.

Temporary Capes.name: Christmas Cape
Temporary Capes.description: The Christmas Cape was temporarily given to players who logged in during the Christmas season of 2010.

Temporary Capes.name: New Year 2011 Cape
Temporary Capes.description: The New Year 2011 Cape was temporarily given to players who logged in during the New Year season of 2011.

Temporary Capes.name: Scrolls Champion Cape
Temporary Capes.description: The Scrolls Champion Cape was given to players who won the Scrolls Championship in 2015.

Temporary Capes.name: Xbox 1st Birthday Cape
Temporary Capes.description: The Xbox 1st Birthday Cape was temporarily shown on all players to celebrate the first anniversary of the Xbox 360 Edition.
